cases.evidence: Original From thence is a PREP+ADV source adjunct, not a fabricated PP; the complete clause we proceeded to Oxford is independently parsed and linked as source of motion. A separate grammatical From there control passes and an omitted-subject near-miss does not use this construction.

Had is overt finite perfect auxiliary, my eyes is a nested possessive plural NP built from lexical eye/plural instead of the misleading singular homograph, deceived is a past participle selecting accusative me. Perfect aspect, agent, patient and possession relations are source-verified, including an independent his/him control.

This professor is the independently proven demonstrative NP subject; singular was governs ADJP headed by unlike, with very as local degree modifier and his colleague as the comparison standard. Independent teacher/her-colleague and failed-agreement controls establish selection.

The exact source letter subscription is a nonfinite documentary NP followed by the independently proven two-part proper-name signatory; both real quotation delimiters and the comma are retained, with no fabricated finite clause. A matched nonmatching source and independent signatory were checked.

Source-preserved quotation encloses a dateline with overt named location, calendar month, source-attested ordinal and an incomplete year 17--; the graph records the missing year digits as unknown, never manufactures a date. Independent Oxford 13th and completed-year negative controls pass.

The overt colon separates the infinitival resolution from a separate imperative Come with me, which has a genuine vocative Henry and purpose to order the horses. Goal, discourse plan, vocative, purpose and object graph relations are tested; a semicolon contrast is rejected.

The storm is agent of hung, exactly north of the town is its direct locative, and the later over-the-part phrase bears the independently identified relative which lies between... attached to the part. Tested with a separate proper-place control and an invalid who-for-which contrast.

So with the second is licensed as conventional anaphoric minor predication with overt so ADV, full with-the-second PP and source stop; the tree deliberately does not invent an unspoken finite verb. The third is a positive independent control, without is an unsuitable contrast.

Original double dash signals abandoned quoted content rather than an invented predicate. The overt I thought...Dr. Livesey spans the interrupted content, while I began is an independently proven external reporting clause. Abbreviation, honorific, selected reporter relation, exact punctuation and an em-dash contrast are checked.

The preposed In the meantime is a temporal PP; I had a better chance independently supplies the matrix clause; as I supposed is a bounded epistemic incise between two real commas; before me is separately parsed as the final location, not a locative of supposed. Both independent pronoun and punctuation controls are tested.

Inverted Had there been a breath of wind is the explicit counterfactual condition; should-have-fallen heads the modal consequence, the six mutineers contains its source-backed relative who were left aboard, slipped our cable inherits the shared modal, and away to sea is overt directional ellipsis without a fabricated went/gone. The directional shore and ungrammatical fall controls establish the selection.

Vain indeed must be all her attentions is a fronted modal predicative inversion; the following vain and useless attributes govern separate coordinated nominals without supplying missing copulas. The if-clause is a finite source-backed condition, and self-destined-for-another remains an explicit adjectival complement. Independent time and coordination controls checked.
